annotations.title: Token supply, total supply: any ERC-20

description: Total supply of any ERC-20 token on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon, read live from the contract: raw and decimal-adjusted supply, decimals, name and symbol. Give a 0x address or a known ticker (USDC, USDT, WETH, DAI…). Use to check a token's circulating maximum or compare supply across chains. Example: token=USDC. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
